info.title: SmartSuite Universal API
info.description: Manage workflows, records, and business operations in SmartSuite

post.description: Creates a new comment in SmartSuite.

connectionId.description: The MindCloud connection ID for this app.

recordId.description: The SmartSuite record ID to add the comment to.

tableId.description: The SmartSuite table ID that owns the record.

messageHtml.description:
The comment body as HTML, for example `

Hello

`.

assignedTo.description: Optional SmartSuite assignee member ID for the comment.

parentComment.description: Optional parent comment ID when replying to an existing comment.

post.description: Creates a new view in SmartSuite.

connectionId.description: The MindCloud connection ID for this app.

tableId.description: The SmartSuite table ID the view belongs to.

solutionId.description: The SmartSuite solution ID containing the table.

label.description: The label shown for the new SmartSuite view.

viewMode.description: The SmartSuite view mode, such as grid.

state.description: The SmartSuite view state object, including visible fields and filter settings.

order.description: Optional ordering value for the view.

autosave.description: Whether the SmartSuite view autosaves changes.

isDirty.description: Internal SmartSuite dirty-state flag for the view.

isLocked.description: Whether the SmartSuite view is locked.

isPasswordProtected.description: Whether the SmartSuite view is password protected.

isPrivate.description: Whether the SmartSuite view is private.

mapState.description: Map configuration state for map views.

sharingAllowAllFields.description: Whether shared views expose all fields.

sharingAllowOpenRecords.description: Whether shared views allow opening records.

sharingEnabled.description: Whether sharing is enabled for the view.

sharingPassword.description: Optional password for the shared view.

sharingShowToolbar.description: Whether shared views show the toolbar.
